classification_notes: For comparability, Manchester United's 2011/12 figures were taken from the official Manchester United plc annual report on Form 20-F rather than the narrower club-limited Companies House filing. The plc report provides the consolidated Commercial, Broadcasting, Matchday, employee benefit, and net debt disclosures that align with the project methodology.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the source used here.
non_football_revenue_notes: Commercial revenue in the plc report includes sponsorship, retail, merchandising, apparel and product licensing, and new media/mobile activities within the club's commercial segment.

notes: Values in the annual report were disclosed in GBP millions or GBP thousands and have been converted here into full GBP amounts. This source was chosen because it provides the comparable consolidated sector revenue and debt view required for the project.
